candidates.title: Next.js (App Router) + TypeScript on Vercel — static marketing pages, client-island 3D, one lead API route, Neon Postgres + Resend
candidates.structure: src/app (routes: / landing, /join wizard, /api/waitlist route handler) · src/components (section components per design band) · src/components/three (FitmentWheel, IndoGlobe — client-only islands, dynamic import, no SSR) · src/lib/i18n (TXT copy maps EN/ID mirroring the design keys, lang context + localStorage persistence) · src/lib/db (drizzle schema + client for waitlist_leads) · src/lib/email (Resend notification template) · public/assets (logos, part sprites, icons, unify-graph.mp4) · public/fonts (self-hosted Plus Jakarta Sans woff2)
conventions: All user-facing strings live ONLY in src/lib/i18n copy maps (both en and id) — no hardcoded copy in components
Brand tokens as CSS custom properties in globals.css matching design/style.json exactly
Design copy rules enforced in code review: no exact fee, no incumbent names, 'Early Adaptors' spelling
patterns: Server components for static sections; 'use client' islands only for interactive pieces (language toggle, rotator, wizard, 3D scenes, scroll reveal)
three.js scenes as self-contained client components honoring the design's lang/static contract; three imported from npm (not unpkg CDN), lazy-loaded via next/dynamic + IntersectionObserver
POST /api/waitlist: zod-validated payload → honeypot + rate-limit check → drizzle insert into Postgres → Resend email alert to the team → 200; client shows success only after 200
prefers-reduced-motion media handling centralized in a useReducedMotion hook feeding all animated components
next/image for logos/sprites with explicit sizes; fonts via @font-face with font-display swap
candidates.test_approach: Vitest unit tests: waitlist payload validation (zod schema incl. honeypot/limits), wa.me link builder, i18n completeness (every key present in both en and id), numbers-canon switch; plus a green smoke suite at foundation. Playwright e2e (wizard happy path + language toggle) added as a later change.
security: Server-side zod validation + field length limits on /api/waitlist
Honeypot rejection and per-IP rate limiting on the lead endpoint
Secrets (DATABASE_URL, RESEND_API_KEY) only in Vercel env vars — never in client bundles
HTTPS-only; no third-party trackers without approval
performance: LCP < 2.5s mobile: hero copy renders server-side before any 3D loads; three.js code-split and deferred until idle/in-view
Static generation for both pages (landing fully static; wizard client-side with API)
Optimized assets: resized logos, compressed sprites, latin-subset fonts, lazy muted looping mp4
Animations gated by IntersectionObserver; reduced-motion static fallbacks
candidates.fit_to_intent: Matches every MUST feature: faithful port of the design's DOM/CSS (inline-style design translates to CSS modules/globals with identical tokens), the two three.js custom elements port nearly 1:1 as React-wrapped client components, and the one dynamic need (waitlist persistence + email, per the approved decision) is a single route handler on the same Vercel deployment — no separate backend to operate. Vercel is already connected in the user's tooling.
